title: next-easytour tutorial (0.3.x)
description: JSON schema for a next-easytour step list. Validates arrays of Step objects as defined in src/types.ts.

id.description: Stable, unique identifier for this step. Used for navigation, deep-linking, and lifecycle callbacks.

body.description: Body copy displayed by the default <Card>.

targets.description: Registered target ids this step highlights or points at. Matches the arg passed to useTutorialTarget().

meta.description: Host-owned metadata. Shape is declared by the consumer; the library preserves it verbatim.

x.description: Horizontal position as a percentage of the target's width. May fall outside 0–100.

y.description: Vertical position as a percentage of the target's height. May fall outside 0–100.

x.description: Horizontal position as a percentage of the viewport width. May fall outside 0–100.

y.description: Vertical position as a percentage of the viewport height. May fall outside 0–100.

spotlight.description: Dim the viewport except for cutouts around the step's targets.

x.description: Centre x, percentage of target width.

y.description: Centre y, percentage of target height.

r.description: Horizontal radius, percentage of target width.

ry.description: Vertical radius, percentage of target height. Defaults to r (circle).

label.description: Optional label rendered below the ellipse.
